initialize_data_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for a voxelization dataset class with configurable augmentation, transforms, and distributed sampling
VoxelizationDataset: build a PyTorch dataset class that loads RGB point clouds, voxelizes them, and applies coordinate and feature augmentation
VoxelizationDatasetBase_load_ply: load a PLY point cloud file and extract coordinates, RGB features, and semantic labels as numpy arrays
VoxelizationDataset_convert_mat2cfl: convert a raw numpy matrix of point cloud data into separate coordinates, features, and labels arrays
DatasetPhase: convert between dataset phase enum values and their string representations for train, val, test, and debug phases
